resources.string: One Reel, then it stops. Swipe to a second one and it backs out.

Watches Instagram\'s on-screen layout only to tell Stories apart from the Reels player, and to detect when the Reels player tries to move to a second video. It does not read message content, photos, or anything outside Instagram.
Ongoing notification that keeps the Reels blocker running reliably in the background.
One Reel per visit, then back. Stories are never touched.
✅ Protection is ON\nOne Reel allowed, then swiping to the next backs out.
⚠️ Protection is OFF\nTurn on the ReelsBlocker accessibility service below.
Couldn\'t open that settings screen on this device.

ReelsBlocker only watches the Instagram app's screen layout through Android's Accessibility API — it never reads your messages, photos, or anything outside Instagram.

• Stories always play normally, never counted.
• Opening the Reels player — from anywhere: feed, Explore, a DM, a profile — always plays that first video freely.
• Swiping to a second Reel (or Instagram auto-advancing to one) immediately backs out of the player.
• Leave the player and open a new Reel, and you get one free video again.
